note: FloodAssist Assam does not collect donations and is not affiliated with these organisations. Each button opens that organisation’s own website in a new tab.

channels.name: Bondhu Streams — Assam Flood Relief
channels.organization: Initiative by Bondhu Streams × Dhiman Streams × Daden Group
channels.summary: Creator-run Assam flood relief page with a public donation ledger.

channels.name: National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)
channels.organization: Ministry of Home Affairs · Government of India
channels.summary: Central government disaster response fund. Donations can be made on the BharatKosh portal.
channels.howTo: On BharatKosh choose Quick Payment → Ministry: Home Affairs → Purpose: Contributions/Grants to NDRF.

account.name: Contributions / Grants to NDRF
account.bank: State Bank of India, Central Secretariat Branch, New Delhi

channels.paymentSource: Bank details as published by the Ministry of Home Affairs for NDRF contributions.

channels.name: PM CARES Fund
channels.organization: Prime Minister's Office · Government of India
channels.summary: Public charitable trust for emergency and distress relief. Donations can be made on pmcares.gov.in.
channels.howTo: Opens the official PM CARES domestic donation page.

account.name: PM CARES
account.bank: State Bank of India, New Delhi Main Branch

channels.paymentSource: UPI and bank details as published on pmindia.gov.in / pmcares.gov.in.

channels.summary: Goonj’s Rahat Floods campaign page for flood relief contributions.

channels.name: SEEDS India — Flood Response
